title: Weather and zero-shot forecasting models: backtest results for GB electricity demand (part 1 of 2)
note: Description: second study in a series. Chronos-2, Timestral-209M and TimesFM 2.5 zero-shot and a weekly-lag regression forecast GB national demand a day ahead with the same weather (ECMWF open-data forecasts as public at the 09:30 issue time, ERA5 history). Preregistered backtest, 960 days, 16 Mar 2024 to 31 Oct 2026; plan, code and inputs frozen at tag weather-plan on 10 Nov 2026; scored once.

title: Weather and zero-shot forecasting models: backtest results for GB electricity demand (part 1 of 2)
note: Description, results: weather cut mean daily error by 34% for the regression, 32% for Chronos-2, 23% for Timestral, 6% for TimesFM 2.5, each confirmed at a 5% study-wide error rate. Chronos-2 closed 62% of its gap to NESO's forecast. The models' edge over the weather-free regression largely disappears with weather. Backtest may overlap training data; a live window to 31 Mar 2027 is part 2.

title: weather_study/RESULTS.md at tag weather-results-backtest (gb-foundation-model-tests)
note: Design: each day D forecast at 09:30 UK time on D-1 from demand to 08:30, eight weeks of half-hours as context; error = MAE over D's half-hours in MW against NESO's INDO outturn. Weather: national temperature, wind speed, solar radiation; forecast day from ECMWF 00 UTC run of D-1 (D-2 on 186 fallback days). 960 days, none excluded. Scored once on 11 Nov 2026; all 20 gate checks passed.

title: weather_study/RESULTS.md at tag weather-results-backtest (gb-foundation-model-tests)
note: Q1 (confirmatory, one-sided, each at 0.0125, 7-day block bootstrap, 2,000 draws). Mean daily error without -> with weather, ratio (90% interval): regression 1,541 -> 1,014 MW, 0.658 (0.631-0.686); Chronos-2 1,436 -> 980, 0.683 (0.658-0.707); Timestral 1,409 -> 1,089, 0.773 (0.751-0.796); TimesFM 2.5 1,567 -> 1,474, 0.941 (0.913-0.968). All four met; p < 0.0005.

title: weather_study/RESULTS.md at tag weather-results-backtest (gb-foundation-model-tests)
note: Q3 (estimate, no test): model error divided by the regression's, same weather, 90% interval: Chronos-2 0.966 (0.931-1.001), Timestral 1.074 (1.034-1.115), TimesFM 2.5 1.453 (1.394-1.510); without weather the first study gave 0.932, 0.914, 1.017. Q2: NESO error 700 MW; weather closed 62% of Chronos-2's gap (456 MW, 414-500), 45% for Timestral, 11% for TimesFM 2.5; Chronos-2 still trails by 280 MW.

title: weather_study/RESULTS.md at tag weather-results-backtest (gb-foundation-model-tests)
note: Pinned revisions: amazon/chronos-2 29ec376, mistralai/Timestral-209M 9874d25, google/timesfm-2.5-200m-pytorch 1d95242. Regression gets temperature, its square, wind, a temperature-wind term and solar per half-hour, refit daily on the year to D-2 on unrescaled ERA5; models' ERA5 history is rescaled to ECMWF (check E3: effect about 1 MW). TimesFM 2.5 takes weather via a linear fit on its context.

title: weather_study/RESULTS.md at tag weather-results-backtest (gb-foundation-model-tests)
note: Exploratory E1, with/without-weather ratio on days after release: Chronos-2 (30 Oct 2025) 0.664 (0.631-0.703) on 367 days vs 0.695 before; TimesFM 2.5 (15 Sep 2025) 0.948 on 412 days; Timestral (15 Oct 2026) only 17 days. Winter-only ratio: regression 0.575, Chronos-2 0.624. On 21 bank holidays weather helped less. Caveats: possible training leakage, one weather source, zero-shot only.
